items.computation: Anchor is the invoice date, 17.12.2025 (Wednesday). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event itself is not counted, so counting starts on 18.12.2025. Adding 7 days (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) lands on 24.12.2025 (Wednesday). That day is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW (Heiligabend is not a statutory holiday), so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Due date: 24.12.2025.
